description:
Returns one domain of your account with the DNS records to publish and the verification
status of the domain and of every record. It only reads; it does not verify anything. A domain
still registering shows `status: PENDING` with `dns_records: []`.

It works without the custom email domain add-on, so you can inspect what the account holds.
A domain of another account, or one already removed, answers `404`.

BeeL API endpoint: GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}/email-domains/{email_domain_id} (reference: https://docs.beel.es)

account_id.description: Your own account, or an account you provisioned. The account in the path, not the credential, decides which account the operation acts on. A `403` is returned when you do not reach it, the same response an account that does not exist gets.

name: beel_get_email_domain
